payload.body: An all-pass filter is a human-made signal-processing filter designed to pass all frequency components with unity gain while introducing a frequency-dependent phase shift. Parameters: (1) the phase response function θ(f) or equivalently the group delay τ_g(f) = -dθ/df, (2) the pole-zero configuration (poles and zeros arranged in reciprocal pairs across the unit circle in the z-plane, or conjugate mirror pairs in the s-plane for continuous-time), (3) the order N (determining the complexity and flexibility of the phase response), (4) the delay profile specification (constant, linear, or custom group delay). Persistence mechanism: implemented as DSP algorithms in digital audio workstations, communications equalizers, and phase-correction toolchains; encoded as rational transfer functions H(s) = N(s)/D(s) where N(s) is the reverse of D(s) for continuous-time, or H(z) = z^{-N}D(z^{-1})/D(z) for discrete-time; persists through filter-design textbooks, DSP library implementations, and standardized phase-equalization circuits. [formal: transitus omnimodus | substrate: behavior | horizon: a moment | explicit: yes | epoch: 0.04]

The cepstrum (Atanasoff 1947) is defined mathematically via the Fourier transform of the log spectrum — the CONTINUOUS Fourier transform suffices, and did, before the DFT existed. The DFT/FFT is one computational engine for the concept, not its constitutive one; remove DFT and cepstral analysis keeps operating (continuous-domain cepstra, or any other transform evaluation). 'Computation stops working' conflates one implementation with the construct — the standard alternative-transducer failure of Law 8's removal test. If the filer wanted 'cepstral analysis is usually computed with the DFT,' that is association, not dependency.

(Contrast with the DEPENDS_ON edges in this batch: this is a historical derivation, which is exactly what DERIVED_FROM carries.)
